Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Moonlit Wake triggers, causing you to gain 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

Activate Gruul Turf by tapping it, adding {R}{R}{R}{G}{G}{G} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Clever Conjurer by tapping it, untapping Gruul Turf

Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.

Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.

Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Reluctant Role Model triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat from step 5.

Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.

When Leonin Relic-Warder leaves the battlefield, its last ability triggers, returning itself from exile to the battlefield.

as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-4753-5361.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-4753-5361.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Clever Impersonator and Auton Soldier each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Clever Impersonator trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Auton Soldier trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-4753-5361.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

849-2946-4871-5256.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
849-2946-4871-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Anax trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

670-1619-4142-6154.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-4142-6154.description:
Cast Hostage Taker by paying its mana cost.
When Hostage Taker enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Hostage Taker trigger, exiling White Plume Adventurer until Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Hostage Taker.
Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield, causing White Plume Adventurer to be returned to the battlefield from exile.
When White Plume Adventurer enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the White Plume Adventurer trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Hostage Taker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Hostage Taker enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Hostage Taker trigger, exiling White Plume Adventurer until Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Hostage Taker.
Repeat from step 5.

Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.

1322-2033-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

Resolve the Proper Burial trigger, causing you to gain 12 life

Mirror Room is locked.
Fractured Realm is unlocked.
5299-5921-5970-6968--112.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, creating a token copy of Marina.
Put the tapped Marina into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Marina token enters the battlefield, it's first ability triggers twice, causing you to look at the top seven cards of your library and put all enchantment cards from among them into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library, and then repeat this once.
Resolve the second Mirror Room trigger, creating a token copy of itself, as it is a creature due to Opalescence.
Activate the Marina token by tapping it, unlocking the token Mirror Room.
Repeat from step 2.

240-643-1209-3466.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
240-643-1209-3466.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control by any method.
When that creature enters the battlefield, Reaper King triggers, destroying that creature.
Resolve Atla Palani's trigger, revealing cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2 until Kozilek enters the battlefield then dies, or until you choose to end the loop by destroying an opponent's permanent.
If Kozilek dies, it and Atla Palani trigger.
Resolve Kozilek's trigger, shuffling your graveyard into your library.
Continue from step 3.

478-2092-2645-4241.notablePrerequisites:
Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 5 or greater.
You control up to six lands that can tap to produce at least {6}.
Candelabra of Tawnos does not have summoning sickness.
478-2092-2645-4241.description:
Activate up to six lands by tapping them, adding at least {6}.

Activate Candelabra of Tawnos by tapping it and paying {1} due to Agatha of the Vile Cauldron, untapping the up to six lands.
Activate up to six lands by tapping them, adding at least {6}.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3}, untapping Candelabra of Tawnos.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 3.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Staff of Domination's other abilities.

2011-3598-4050.notablePrerequisites:

2011-3598-4050.description:

Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
If Rapacious One has power six or greater and/or a Warrior you control can attack, this combo nets infinite creature tokens.

Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Activate Jetfire, Ingenious Scientist by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, adding {3} and converting Jetfire.

Resolve the copy of Descent into Avernus' ability, putting two descent counters on it, then causing each player to create a number of Treasure tokens equal to the number of descent counters on it, and then deal that much damage to each opponent.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Treasures, untapping Lithoform Engine.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Repeat from step 2.

Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Myr Battlesphere, adding {B}.
Myr Battlesphere dies, triggering Cryptek twice.
Resolve the first Cryptek trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the second Cryptek trigger, returning Myr Battlesphere from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, creating four 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Myr, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1283-1328-2011-4923.notablePrerequisites:

Spellbinder triggers, casting a copy of Cabal Ritual without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Cabal Ritual, adding {5}.
Activate Najeela by paying {5}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.

914-1235-4719.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-1235-4719.description:

The tokens enter the battlefield, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Dockside Extortionist trigger, creating at least six Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Anarchist trigger, returning Twinflame from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate five Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

152-1558-4840.description:
Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying {7}, creating a token copy of Myr Battlesphere with haste.
The Myr Battlesphere token enters the battlefield, creating four 1/1 Myr creature tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it, sacrificing the Myr Battlesphere token and sacrificing the four Myr tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
